facts.text: The hotel is located next to Taormina's Greek Theatre.
facts.excerpt: Located next to Taormina's Greek Theatre and with Mount Etna in sight

facts.text: The hotel's story began in 1850 as a guesthouse for artists and painters drawn to Taormina by its views.
facts.excerpt: Our story began in 1850 as a humble guesthouse for the art scene andpainters who were drawn to Taormina by the scenic views.

facts.text: German artist Otto Geleng stayed at the hotel to witness the Greek Theatre, and his paintings from the terrace captured the world's imagination.
facts.excerpt: German artist Otto Geleng stayed with us to witness the wonders of the Greek Theatre

facts.text: Otto Geleng, the hotel's restaurant, was awarded a star by the Michelin Guide in 2026.
facts.excerpt: Otto Geleng, awarded with a star by the Michelin Guide in 2026

facts.text: Ristorante Timeo serves seasonal Sicilian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal Sicilian cuisine at Ristorante Timeo

facts.text: Bar Clementina serves cocktails inside Villa Timeo.
facts.excerpt: Cocktails at Bar Clementina, inside Villa Timeo

facts.text: The hotel has a heated outdoor pool.
There is an infinity pool at Villa Timeo.
The hotel has a Dior Spa.
The hotel is a 1-hour drive from Catania Airport.
Guests have access to the Lido Villeggiatura beach club at Villa Sant'Andrea.
facts.excerpt: Access to Lido Villeggiatura beach club at Villa Sant’Andrea

facts.text: A complimentary shuttle runs to Lido Villeggiatura at Villa Sant'Andrea.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary shuttle to Lido Villeggiatura at Villa Sant’Andrea

facts.text: Families can ask about the Children's Welcome Kit and babysitting services.
facts.excerpt: ask about the Children’s Welcome Kit, babysitting services

facts.text: The spa has three single treatment rooms and one couples treatment room, plus a hair salon.
facts.excerpt: standout standalone spa with three single treatment rooms and one couples treatment room, plus a hair salon

facts.text: Timeo Grill is described as a poolside eatery that was closed for the season at the time of the Conde Nast Traveler review.
